newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech FinMin asked to hasten 2nd flood bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Czech FinMin asked to hasten 2nd flood bond issue.

text.p: The Czech government has asked the Finance Ministry to speed up the issue of a second, one billion crown ($28.7 million) tranche of five-year domestic bonds to pay for flood relief, Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus said on Wednesday.
"It's possible that the issue (originally planned to be launched on September 1) may occur a few days earlier," Klaus told journalists after a weekly government meeting.
